items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: As I mentioned, Don Byas used to come over and play with us in Hot Lips Page band.

ctx.x: There his atmosphere of these issues from one club to the other sitting in. It is almost like you're in one big club in a sense.

Well, 52nd St., people were coming out of clubs on their breaks and go play with other bands on their breaks. As I mentioned, Don Byas used to come over and play with us in Hot Lips Page band. I think I mentioned before he played this one tune, "Sweet Georgia Brown” and he played over 40 courses on that one occasion. He played 40 choruses and each one was better than the last. It was incredible. And you could understand why a guy like Lucky Thompson would like his style. He had that same stamina, inventiveness,…
Do you see Lucky Thompson as connected to like a Sonny Rollins?
